curseforge_enabled.description: Whether the artifact(s) should be published to Curseforge
curseforge_enabled.title: Deploy to Curseforge

modrinth_enabled.description: Whether the artifact(s) should be published to Modrinth
modrinth_enabled.title: Deploy to Modrinth

discord_enabled.description: Whether the normal release artifact(s) should be announced to Discord
discord_enabled.title: Announce on Discord

discord_announce_nightly_builds.title: Announce nightly builds to discord
discord_announce_nightly_builds.description: Whether nightly builds should be announced and uploaded to the nightly webhook

curseforge_project_slug.description: The Curseforge project slug. When on the mod page, the slug is part of the link: `https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/<slug>`
curseforge_project_slug.title: Curseforge project slug

curseforge_project_id.description: The Curseforge project ID. Project ID (number) can be found in the details section of the mod page.
curseforge_project_id.title: Curseforge project ID

modrinth_project_id.description: The Modrinth project ID. Visit the mod page on Modrinth, click the three dots and copy the the ID.
modrinth_project_id.title: Modrinth project ID

default_release_type.title: Default release type
default_release_type.description: Default release stability type. Can be overriden for each artifact.

username.description: Username used to send the webhook, defaults to the username configured when the webhook URL was created.
username.title: Username

avatar_url.title: Avatar URL
avatar_url.description: Avatar image URL for the webhook, defaults to the avatar configured when the webhook URL was created.

release_content.title: Content message
release_content.description: Set the content message. The following placeholders are available: `{version}`, `{changelog}`. Defaults to: `# Changelog \n{changelog}`

nightly_content.title: Content message for Nightly build
nightly_content.description: Set the content message. Available placeholders: `{version}` - The nightly mod version. Defaults to: `# Nightly build \nv{version}`

nightly_discord_button_label.title: Nightly GitHub link title
nightly_discord_button_label.description: The text of the link to GitHub workflow run containing the nightly build. Available placeholders: `{version}`. Defaults to: `Download from GitHub (Login required)`

artifacts.title: Artifacts / Branches
artifacts.description: Configuration for artifacts that should be released. The Key (identifier) of the artifact if for purposes of this workflow. The name must be complaint with gradle task naming rules. Must not use `<space>` `/` `\` `:` `<` `>` `"` `?` `*` `|`. You should also not use `.` as a leading or trailing character.

common_dependencies.title: Common dependencies
common_dependencies.description: Common dependencies for **each artifact** (all branches). These dependencies will be applied to all published artifacts.

environment.description: Specifies the client and server environment requirements for the project. The options mirror the environment settings from Modrinth, for more details see [New Environments](https://modrinth.com/news/article/new-environments/).

embed.title: Discord Embed
embed.description: An embed object to be sent with the Discord webhook. Available placeholders: `{version}` The mod version **without** 'v' prefix, `{changelog}` The changelog contents. Do not use Discord tags in embed, if you want to send a notifications, use the tag in the standard message content.

description.title: Description
description.description: The description of the embed, discord formatting syntax can be used.

color.title: Color
color.description: Color of the left line used in the discord embed. Full `RRGGBB` hex color prefixed with a `#`.

icon_url.title: Icon URL
icon_url.description: The URL of the footer icon

file_glob.title: File glob
file_glob.description:
The glob for the compiled artifact to be uploaded. Can use `{version}` which will be replaced with the current mod version. E.g. 
`build/libs/*-1.21.1-neoforge-{version}.jar`. The glob must be unique and match a single artifact with unique name. The last part of the glob (for the file name) must not match any other artifact from a different branch!

branch.title: Git Branch
branch.description: The name of the branch from which the artifact is compiled. Currently a branch can be configured only once for a single artifact!

release_type.description: The stability type of the release. If not specified, the Default release type is used.

loaders.title: Mod loaders
loaders.description: Mod loaders that can load the artifact

game_versions.title: Game versions
game_versions.description: Supported game versions for the artifact (e.g. `1.21.1`)

java_version.title: Java version
java_version.description: The java version required to build the branch (e.g. `17`)

discord_button_label.title: Discord announcement button label
discord_button_label.description: Text to use for link button in discord announcement. Available placeholders: `{loaders}`, `{version}`, `{game_versions}`, `{file_name}`, `{platform}`. Defaults to: `{platform}: {loaders} {game_versions}`

version_properties.title: File version replacements
version_properties.description: List of files and respective properties where the version should be set before the artifact is compiled. Only supports properties format (`property=value`). Use your gradle build script to distribute the value to other files. If none is supplied, defaults to `mod_version` in `gradle.properties`.

file.title: File path
file.description: The exact relative path to the file (e.g. `gradle.properties`)

property.title: Property name
property.description: The name of the property which should be set to the version (e.g. `mod_version`)

dependencies.description: Dependencies for the artifact (merged with **common dependencies**)

release_type.title: Release type
release_type.description: The stability type of the release.

mr_dependency.title: Modrinth dependency
mr_dependency.description: Dependency on Modrinth platform. Only one, either ID or slug is required. If you provide both values, ID takes priority and slug is not used.
